submitted.rationale: XRD at 5 compositions from Ca 0.28 to 0.51 all showed the same single peak at Q≈2.77, so it could not tell phases apart. I spent the 3 merit measurements spread across the composition line. The Mn-rich end, index 25 (Ca 0.287), gave 4.45e-6 A. That is about 8x higher than Ca 0.387 (5.9e-7 A) and 12x higher than Ca 0.508 (3.6e-7 A). Photocurrent rises toward higher Mn content.
